description: VAN-021 void approval code vectors. TEST-ONLY secret, never a DEV or production value. key = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(secret, 'sunpride/van-void-approval/v1|' + tripId)) without padding; code = RFC 4226 dynamic truncation of HMAC-SHA256(key bytes, 'VOID|v1|' + tripId + '|' + receiptNumber + '|' + totalMinor + '|' + reasonCode) mod 10^8, zero-padded to 8 digits.
